snippets.caption: Two lexical scores, one fused ranking
snippets.meaning: BM25 term scoring and weighted Chinese character overlap are ranked separately, then combined by reciprocal rank fusion.

snippets.caption: Reject sources that do not support the recognized topic
snippets.meaning: Each paragraph cites only supplied source IDs. Its recognized claim facets must be covered by the cited sources.

snippets.caption: One initial answer, at most one repair
snippets.meaning: range(2) bounds the initial generation plus one possible repair; the deadline bounds total answer time.

metric.limitation: Same-team manual gold labels and a small convenience sample. This is neither an external benchmark nor a measure of answer accuracy, citation entailment, market validity or predictive skill.
